FIRST HERITAGE COMMERCIAL BANK, N.A.
Loan Number: 8842-CRE-2026-118

COMMERCIAL LOAN AGREEMENT

Borrower: Meridian Northwest Coffee Roasters, Inc., a Washington corporation
Guarantor: Marisol T. Kettering, individual (limited guaranty capped at $500,000)
Lender: First Heritage Commercial Bank, N.A.
Loan Amount: $2,400,000 (Term Loan) plus $500,000 (Revolving Line of Credit)
Effective Date: March 1, 2026

1. TERM LOAN FACILITY
   (a) Principal: $2,400,000
   (b) Interest Rate: Wall Street Journal Prime Rate + 1.75%, adjusted quarterly. As of the Effective Date, the initial rate is 9.50%.
   (c) Amortization: 10-year straight-line amortization; 5-year balloon maturity.
   (d) Payment: Monthly principal and interest of approximately $30,354.00, first payment due April 1, 2026; balloon payment due March 1, 2031.
   (e) Prepayment Penalty: 3-2-1 declining prepayment penalty in years 1, 2, and 3; no penalty thereafter.
   (f) Purpose: Financing of leasehold improvements and equipment purchase (2 x Loring S15 Falcon roasters) at 1400 Western Avenue, Seattle, WA 98101.

2. REVOLVING CREDIT FACILITY
   (a) Commitment: $500,000
   (b) Interest Rate: WSJ Prime + 2.25%, floating. Interest-only monthly on outstanding balance.
   (c) Unused Line Fee: 0.35% per annum on the average unused portion.
   (d) Maturity: 364-day facility, subject to annual renewal at Lender's discretion.
   (e) Borrowing Base: 80% of Eligible Accounts Receivable (0-60 days aged) plus 50% of Eligible Green Coffee Inventory, less a $75,000 availability reserve.

3. COLLATERAL
   (a) First priority security interest in all Borrower's business assets, including inventory, accounts receivable, equipment, and general intangibles (UCC-1 to be filed with Washington Secretary of State).
   (b) Collateral assignment of Borrower's leasehold interest at 1400 Western Avenue, Seattle, WA (subject to Landlord's consent and Non-Disturbance Agreement in form acceptable to Lender).
   (c) Assignment of key-person life insurance on Marisol T. Kettering in the amount of $2,400,000 (Northwestern Mutual Policy No. NWM-441028).

4. FINANCIAL COVENANTS
Beginning with the fiscal quarter ending June 30, 2026, Borrower shall maintain:
   (a) Debt Service Coverage Ratio not less than 1.25 to 1.00, tested quarterly on a trailing four-quarter basis.
   (b) Debt-to-Tangible-Net-Worth Ratio not to exceed 3.00 to 1.00, tested quarterly.
   (c) Minimum Tangible Net Worth of $850,000 at all times, stepping up to $1,100,000 by December 31, 2027.
   (d) Capital Expenditures not to exceed $250,000 per fiscal year without Lender's prior written consent.

5. REPORTING REQUIREMENTS
   (a) Annual audited financial statements within 120 days of fiscal year-end, prepared by an independent CPA acceptable to Lender.
   (b) Quarterly internally prepared financial statements within 45 days of quarter-end.
   (c) Monthly borrowing base certificate (for the revolving facility) within 20 days of month-end.
   (d) Annual personal financial statement of Guarantor within 90 days of the Guarantor's fiscal year-end.
   (e) Copies of federal tax returns within 30 days of filing.

6. EVENTS OF DEFAULT
The following constitute Events of Default:
   (a) Non-payment of any amount within 10 days after due date.
   (b) Breach of any financial covenant, uncured for 30 days after Lender notice.
   (c) Cross-default on any indebtedness in excess of $50,000.
   (d) Death or incapacity of the Guarantor without a replacement guarantor acceptable to Lender within 60 days.
   (e) Change of control of Borrower (defined as any transaction resulting in Marisol T. Kettering owning less than 51% of the voting equity of Borrower) without Lender's prior written consent.
   (f) Material adverse change in the financial condition or business prospects of Borrower.

7. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement is governed by federal law, and to the extent not preempted, the laws of the State of Washington.
